title: Logic for Programmers
summary: A free interactive book teaching mathematical logic specifically designed for programmers who want to understand formal reasoning, proofs, and logical foundations that underlie computer science and software development.
problem_solved: Helps programmers bridge the gap between intuitive coding and rigorous mathematical reasoning needed for advanced programming, algorithm design, and formal verification.
why_valuable: Makes abstract mathematical logic accessible and practical for developers through programming-focused explanations, transforming theoretical concepts into applicable skills for writing more reliable and correct software.
